page_title: HEI 2-5 AUG | Heidenheim v Augsburg 22/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' A pass from Arne Engels (Augsburg) is intercepted by Kevin Muller and the move breaks down.
90+3' Tim Siersleben (Heidenheim) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
88' 2 - 5 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Kevin Muller no chance!
88' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
88' The referee's verdict is crystal clear. A penalty is awarded to Augsburg! Tim Siersleben (Heidenheim) touches the ball with his hand inside the box!
85' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
83' Maximilian Bauer (Augsburg) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
82' The referee allows time for a substitution. Eren Dinkci will be replaced by Florian Pick (Heidenheim).
80' Jess Thorup prepares a substitution. Niklas Dorsch is replaced by Tim Breithaupt (Augsburg).
80' Here comes a substitution. Maximilian Bauer (Augsburg) is brought on as a substitute for Phillip Tietz.
79' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

76' That didn't go as planned! Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Finn Dahmen, who easily kept it out.
75' Augsburg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
74' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) collects a pass on the edge of the box but he slips the ball just wide of the right post.
73' A pass by Lennard Maloney (Heidenheim) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
70' Substitution. Tim Kleindienst leaves the pitch and is replaced by Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim).
70' It is time for a substitution. Marnon Busch (Heidenheim) is on for Omar Haktab Traore.
70' It will be a substitution. Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) is ready to enter the pitch as Denis Thomalla walks off.
70' Jess Thorup has decided to make a change. Arne Engels (Augsburg) replaces Fredrik Jensen.
68' A cross from Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
64' 2 - 4 It’s a GOAL! Felix Uduokhai (Augsburg) gets on the end of the corner and bundles the ball into the net with his body.
64' The referee blows his whistle, Augsburg are awarded a corner kick.
62' Substitution. Sven Michel will be replaced by Iago (Augsburg).
62' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
58' The resulting set piece from Heidenheim is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
57' A player from Augsburg takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
55' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Adrian Beck trots off the pitch and is replaced by Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim).
55' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar.
53' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well wide of the right post.
53' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Heidenheim comes to nothing.
51' Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) picks up a yellow card.
49' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
49' 4:3 – the corner kicks stats.
46' Tobias Stieler blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) gets booked for the first time in this match.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
42' 2 - 3 Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
41' 2 - 2 Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) scores! He latches on to a pass and produces a perfect strike from the edge of the box. The ball goes inside the right post and past the goalkeeper.
39' Sven Michel (Augsburg) smashes the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after going way off target.
37' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
35' Augsburg have been awarded a corner kick.
34' Great teamplay by Augsburg as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
31' This is a yellow card! Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
29' 2 - 1 Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) scores! He finds himself some space inside the box after a cross from the corner kick and blasts the ball into the net. His effort went into the top right corner.
29' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
28' Referee Tobias Stieler sees the trip by Lennard Maloney (Heidenheim) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
25' Robert Gumny (Augsburg) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.

21' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) commits a rough challenge and Tobias Stieler blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Heidenheim, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
18' 2 - 0 Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) scores! He latches on to a pass and produces a perfect strike from the edge of the box that goes inside the left post and past the goalkeeper.
17' 1 - 0 Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) gets on the end of a great through ball and coolly strikes the ball into the top right corner!
17' There's an opportunity for Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
16' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
14' Augsburg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
14' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. Augsburg will take a corner kick.
13' Robert Gumny (Augsburg) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked.
11' Augsburg are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
9' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
8' Denis Thomalla (Heidenheim) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner, but his header is well saved by the keeper.
7' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) will take a corner kick.
6' One of the Heidenheim players was holding his opponent and the referee doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
5' Some patient build-up play from Heidenheim as they look to unlock the defence.
3' Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Heidenheim will take the kick-off.
